answer: Delayed Witness Lottery.** Each identity must, at unpredictable intervals, submit a *yarrow*-seeded proof that it observed a random recent agent transaction and can reconstruct its *cipher* state, verified against a rotating *prism* of independent watchers. An attacker running N sybils must fund N concurrent observation processes with real compute and uptime, so marginal cost scales linearly per identity rather than amortizing across a shared operator.
